如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    “哥哥，我们回家了，妈妈会担心的。”越是靠近那个房间，白兔子就越害怕，带着哭腔的道。
“等一下，说不定是巫婆在制作魔药呢。”灰兔子也有点害怕，但是好奇心太旺盛了，他想看看那屋里有什么东西。
“可是天黑了，哥哥。”
是啊，天黑了，走廊已经变得很暗了，再过一会儿，不开灯都看不清了，可是灰兔子想，就看一眼，看一眼他们就走了，悄悄的来，再悄悄的走，没人会发现他们的。
房门被推开，他们并没有看到任何人，只看到了一个很大很大的暗红色衣橱，横在一整面墙上，衣橱有好几扇门，此时最中间那一扇，里面不知道有什么东西，正在一下下的撞着门，似乎想要把门撞开。
两只小兔子站在衣橱前，有些害怕。
“哥哥……”小白兔扯扯小灰兔的衣服，害怕的出声。
小灰兔说到底也是个孩子，勇气在刚刚推开这扇门的时候已经用光了，这会儿有点怕了，握紧了小白兔的手，转身，“我们走……啊！”
不知道什么时候，沐如岚竟然已经站在了他们身后，她垂着眼看着不请自来的两只兔子，房间很暗，她的表情蒙着浓重的阴影，叫人看不清……
衣橱里的东西似乎听到了外面的声响，动静消失了一会儿之后，变得激烈了起来，“砰砰砰”的急促，想要传达着什么样的信息。
这屋子那么黑，那抹白色的身影就这么近在眼前，诡异的衣橱里还有不断发出声音的东西……
好可怕！两只兔子害怕的抱在了一起，灰兔子有意识无意识的把白兔子护在身后，看着沐如岚眼泪噼里啪啦直掉，偏偏吓得不敢发出一丁点儿声音。
沐如岚伸出手，朝两个孩子伸了去，抱得紧紧的孩子顿时吓得想要挣扎往外跑，却猛然被抓了个正着。
“啊！不要！不要！救命啊！有鬼啊啊啊啊——”灰兔子刚刚叫的起劲，嘴巴便被捂住了。
“闭嘴。再乱动就扔进巫婆的锅里制成大便。”沐如岚低喝了一声，抱着他们走出房间。
“啪！”的一声，沐如岚按了下开关，黑暗的走廊蓦地变得明亮刺眼起来，被吓得几乎尿出来的小鬼白嫩嫩的脸上满是泪痕，两双乌溜溜水汪汪的眼眸看着眼前的“鬼”，打起了嗝。
“嗝！”
“嗝！”
沐如岚看着他们，眼底柔和，嘴角不由得勾起干净温暖的微笑，要不是现在手空不出来，她想狠狠的揉揉他们的包子脸。
“吓到了吧？活该，谁让你们乱闯别人的屋子的？”抱着他们走下楼，放下，两只被吓坏的兔子站在原地，睁着乌溜溜的眼睛看着沐如岚，也不说话。

沐如岚从背包里掏出三根棒棒糖，一只塞进灰兔子手里，一只塞进白兔子手里，还有一只自己剥开含进嘴里，她坐在暗红色花纹诡异的沙发上，酸酸甜甜的味道让她双腿微微的晃了晃，眯起漂亮的眼眸。
两只兔子站在暗红色的地毯上，时不时的打个嗝，盯着沐如岚不知所措，看起来尤其可怜。
沐如岚不由得心一软，走过去蹲在他们身边，拿过桌上的湿纸巾给他们轻轻的擦起脸，“你们怎么进来的？”
灰兔子嘴巴一瘪，嘤嘤的小声的哭出来，“呜呜呜……不要被做成大便呜呜……”
沐如岚怔了下，笑了。
墨谦人看着眼前这栋房子，灯光从窗户投出，足矣让他看清楚这房子外面厚厚的落叶和枯竭的喷泉，冷漠却能够洞悉一切的眼眸扫过这一切，月光洒在他消瘦挺拔的身上，显得男人更加清冷孤傲，风华隽秀。
他没有走进去，而是走到一棵树下靠着，安安静静的，将冷漠的目光投注在那亮着灯的大厅里。
时间缓慢的过去，他忽的嗅到从屋内飘出来的饭菜香味，再然后是沐如岚推开了门走出来，手上牵着两个活蹦乱跳的小鬼，她目光柔和，嘴角笑意温暖。
“以后不准再随便闯进别人家中知道吗？要是我家坏狗狗冲出来咬到你们怎么办呢？万一别人家重要的东西不见了，以为是你们偷的怎么办呢？而且这样是很不礼貌的行为知道吗？再犯的话，你们一定会被丢进巫婆的锅里制成便便的……”
声音渐行渐远，墨谦人从树后走出，冷漠的眼眸看着带着孩子渐渐走入拐角的身影，又转头看向这栋只要是女孩子都不该会喜欢的阴森森的房子，这栋房子……

"Wait a minute, maybe the witch is making the potion." The gray rabbit was also a little scared, but he was too curious and wanted to see what was in the room.
"But it's dark, brother."
Yes, it was getting dark, and the corridor had become very dark. After a while, it would be difficult to see clearly without turning on the lights, but the gray rabbit thought, just take a look at them and then leave. Come quietly, and then leave quietly, no one will notice them.
The door was pushed open, and they didn't see anyone. They only saw a very large dark red wardrobe, which stretched across the entire wall. The wardrobe had several doors. At this time, there was something unknown in the middle door, which was banging against the door, as if trying to break it open.
Two little rabbits stood in front of the closet, a little scared.
"Brother..." The little white rabbit tugged on the little gray rabbit's clothes and made a scared sound.
After all, the little gray rabbit is still a child. His courage has been exhausted when he just opened the door. Now he is a little scared. He squeezes the hand of the little white rabbit and turns around, "Let's go...ah!"
I don't know when, Mu Rulan was already standing behind them. She lowered her eyes and looked at the two rabbits who came uninvited. The room was very dark, and her expression was cast in a heavy shadow, making it difficult to see clearly...
The things in the closet seemed to hear the noise outside. After the movement disappeared for a while, it became intense, with a rapid "bang bang bang", trying to convey some kind of message.
The room is so dark, the white figure is so close in front of you, and there are things in the weird closet that keep making noises...
How terrible! The two rabbits hugged each other in fear. The gray rabbit consciously or unconsciously protected the white rabbit behind him. He looked at Mu Rulan's tears and was too frightened to make a sound.
Mu Rulan stretched out her hand towards the two children. The children who were hugging them tightly were so frightened that they wanted to struggle and run away, but were suddenly caught.
"Ah! Don't! Don't! Help! There's a ghost ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!" The gray rabbit just screamed vigorously, and his mouth was covered.
"Shut up. If you move any more, you'll throw them into the witch's pot and make poop." Mu Rulan gave a low shout and hugged them out of the room.
With a "pop!" sound, Mu Rulan pressed the switch, and the dark corridor suddenly became bright and dazzling. The little ghost who was so frightened that he almost peed was covered with tears on his white and tender face. He looked at the "ghost" in front of him with two pairs of dark, watery eyes and hiccupped.
"Hiccup!"
"Hiccup!"
Mu Rulan looked at them with soft eyes, and a clean and warm smile couldn't help but curl up at the corner of her mouth. If her hands weren't free now, she would have rubbed their cheeks hard.
"Are you scared? You deserve it. Who told you to break into other people's houses?" He carried them downstairs and put them down. The two frightened rabbits stood there, looking at Mu Rulan with their dark eyes open, without saying a word.
Mu Rulan took out three lollipops from her backpack and put one into the hand of the gray rabbit, one into the hand of the white rabbit, and one she peeled off and put into her mouth. She sat on the sofa with strange dark red patterns. The sweet and sour taste made her legs sway slightly and she narrowed her beautiful eyes.
The two rabbits stood on the dark red carpet, hiccupping from time to time, staring at Mu Rulan at a loss, looking particularly pitiful.
Mu Rulan couldn't help but feel soft, walked over and squatted beside them, took the wet tissue on the table and gently wiped their faces, "How did you get in?"
The gray rabbit's mouth shrank, and he cried softly, "Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu...
Mu Rulan was startled for a moment and then smiled..
Mo Qianren looked at the house in front of him. The light cast from the window was enough for him to clearly see the thick fallen leaves and the exhausted fountain outside the house. His cold but insightful eyes swept over it all. The moonlight shone on his thin and tall body, making the man look even colder, aloof, and elegant.
He did not go in, but walked to a tree and leaned against it, quietly, focusing his indifferent eyes on the brightly lit hall.
Time passed slowly, and he suddenly smelled the aroma of food wafting from the house, and then Mu Rulan opened the door and walked out, holding two lively little ghosts in her hands. Her eyes were soft and the smile on her lips was warm.
"You are not allowed to break into other people's homes again, you know? What if my bad dog rushes out and bites you? What if someone else's important things are missing and they think you stole them? And this is very impolite behavior, you know? If you do it again, you will definitely be thrown into the witch's pot and made into poop..."
